simple.meaning: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive , take away , i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָסַף (H622) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 202 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָסַף (ʼâçaph) means to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive , take away , i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 13.
